title: Child with Crown and Red Paint
coreRelationships: The child's face and crown are central, drawing immediate attention.
The bold red paint stroke creates a strong diagonal division and visual tension.
The braille-like dots provide a subtle, textured background element.
The black balloon and its strings add a contrasting dark element and vertical lines.
The blurred child figure contrasts with the sharp edges of the crown and paint.
